job_post_detail.title: Marketing Trainee-2027校招
job_post_detail.description:
As a member of the Brand Event team, directly participate in the planning and execution of company-level global brand events, including major trade shows (CES, IFA, etc.), global product launches, and global creator events, covering the full online and offline process.
Core Responsibilities:
1. Event Planning & Creative Execution
Participate in creative brainstorming and solution design, assist in developing event themes, event flow, and user experience plans, and draft event proposals and execution manuals.
2. Booth Design & Space Management
Coordinate with internal design teams and external exhibition vendors, follow up on booth construction, traffic flow planning, and visual merchandising, and participate in design reviews and on-site build acceptance.
3. Event Operations & On-site Execution
Manage pre-, during, and post-event operations, including operational plans, third-party personnel management, run-throughs, and contingency plans; provide on-site support during events to ensure smooth execution across all areas.
4. Materials Management & Process Optimization
Oversee end-to-end materials management (demand collection, production/procurement, storage and transportation, on-site setup, and post-event recovery and reconciliation), optimize SOPs and cost control.
5. Cross-functional & External Collaboration
Work closely with internal teams including Brand, Product, Design, PR, Legal, etc., and coordinate with overseas/regional marketing colleagues to support localized execution of cross-regional events.
job_post_detail.requirement:
1、Full-time bachelor or master’s degree student graduating in 2027. No strict major requirement; preference for Marketing, Advertising, Media/Communications, Event Management, Design Management, or related fields.
2、Project Management: Logical thinking, ability to multi-task, strong time management and prioritization skills.
3、Communication & Collaboration: Skilled in cross-functional collaboration, able to express needs clearly and proactively drive issue resolution.
4、Detail-oriented: Strong control over materials, processes, and timelines; ability to proactively identify and address gaps.
5、Resilience & Adaptability: Comfortable with project-based rhythms, capable of on-the-spot flexibility and problem-solving.
6、Language Proficiency: English required as a working language – fluent in both verbal and written communication (reading and writing).
